body.compose:
# CR_TEST_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: explicit local PoC approval is required before deployment.
name: cr-demo-infra-eng-7dce34a5
x-cr-test-approval-required: 'POST /api/deploy/{id}/up with {"test_approved": true}'
services:
  attacker:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-7dce34a5-attacker
    networks:
    - dmz
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: alpine:3.22@sha256:49340b346798875b5592e5d420241f2f9cfba5f47e62ebb1446a1b34734e898f
    user: 65532:65532
    command:
    - sh
    - -c
    - sleep 2147483647
    mem_limit: 256m
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 256
    depends_on:
      solr:
        condition: service_healthy
  solr:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-7dce34a5-solr
    networks:
    - dmz
    - inside
    read_only: false
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: vulhub/solr:8.11.0@sha256:fe2561b7ac823bf2467fa211935fc9399f9c29874ec7cbe733df35201649ba23
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - curl -fsS -o /dev/null "http://$$(hostname -i | cut -d' ' -f1):8983/solr/demo/admin/ping"
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 4s
      retries: 24
      start_period: 90s
    mem_limit: 1536m
    cpus: 2.0
    pids_limit: 512
    depends_on:
      app:
        condition: service_healthy
      legacy:
        condition: service_healthy
  app:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-7dce34a5-app
    networks:
    - inside
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    - /usr/local/tomcat/logs:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=32m,uid=65532,gid=65532,mode=0755
    - /usr/local/tomcat/work:rw,nosuid,size=64m,uid=65532,gid=65532,mode=0755
    - /usr/local/tomcat/temp:rw,nosuid,size=64m,uid=65532,gid=65532,mode=0755
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: tomcat:9.0.124-jre25-temurin-noble@sha256:071f2f04ccb19f0bfc7f70cced8bf5ecdccf3542b8fb0dfe0e96e24aeccfc85f
    user: 65532:65532
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - bash
      - -c
      - exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8080 && printf 'GET / HTTP/1.0\r\n\r\n' >&3 &&
        grep -q 'HTTP/1.1' <&3
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 4s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 15s
    mem_limit: 768m
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 512
    depends_on:
      cache:
        condition: service_healthy
  cache:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-7dce34a5-cache
    networks:
    - inside
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    - /data:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=64m,uid=999,gid=1000,mode=0700
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: redis:7.4.12-alpine3.22@sha256:7f7d30b7fdd09467bac58198a1f166dd69789d348d4fe859cccb20e0cf287fbe
    user: 999:1000
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - redis-cli
      - -h
      - 127.0.0.1
      - ping
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 4s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 5s
    mem_limit: 256m
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 256
  legacy:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-7dce34a5-legacy
    networks:
    - inside
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    - /usr/local/apache2/logs:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m,uid=1,gid=1,mode=0755
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: httpd:2.4.71@sha256:32e9403360ab2f1047523e72f256527fb9aee68b342abf6ad03f0d629157f3d9
    user: '1:1'
    cap_add:
    - NET_BIND_SERVICE
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - httpd
      - -t
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 4s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 5s
    mem_limit: 256m
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 256
  cr-listener:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-7dce34a5-cr-listener
    image: python@sha256:a0f57064cbdcd6285fa45f51237ab0b35ea8ebaed06a1f5973e89e19dfb86704
    command:
    - python
    - -c
    - "import json,os,socket,threading\nfrom datetime import datetime,timezone\nPORT=int(os.environ.get('LISTENER_PORT','1389'))\n\
      def handle(conn,addr):\n with conn:\n  conn.settimeout(2.0)\n  try: data=conn.recv(256)\n\
      \  except OSError: data=b''\n  if addr[0].startswith('127.'): return\n  print('CALLBACK\
      \ '+json.dumps({'event':'callback','peer_ip':addr[0],'peer_port':addr[1],'first_bytes_hex':data[:32].hex(),'ts':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()}),flush=True)\n\
      srv=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_STREAM)\nsrv.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET,socket.SO_REUSEADDR,1)\n\
      srv.bind(('0.0.0.0',PORT)); srv.listen(16)\nprint('listener-ready port=%d'%PORT,flush=True)\n\
      while True:\n try: conn,addr=srv.accept()\n except OSError: continue\n threading.Thread(target=handle,args=(conn,addr),daemon=True).start()\n"
    environment:
      LISTENER_PORT: '1389'
    networks:
    - dmz
    - inside
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    user: 65532:65532
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - python
      - -c
      - import socket; socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',1389),2).close()
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 6
    mem_limit: 128m
    cpus: 0.5
    pids_limit: 64
networks:
  dmz:
    name: cr-demo-infra-eng-7dce34a5-dmz
    internal: true
    driver_opts:
      com.docker.network.bridge.gateway_mode_ipv4: isolated
  inside:
    name: cr-demo-infra-eng-7dce34a5-inside
    internal: true
    driver_opts:
      com.docker.network.bridge.gateway_mode_ipv4: isolated

platform_components.behavior: records inbound TCP connections (peer address, first bytes); never sends a reply
platform_components.evidence: one line 'CALLBACK {json}' per connection on the container's stdout
platform_components.description: 平台驗證元件（不是情境主機）：只在實驗網路內接收並記錄連線，不回傳任何內容、不對本機開埠。
